🌌 Unified AstroBot Engine v3
How it works
Trigger: The workflow captures incoming Telegram messages or button callback queries.

Session Retrieval: It fetches the conversation state from Supabase using the user's unique chat_id.

Logic Engine: A centralized JavaScript routing engine processes user inputs, handles state changes (START, AWAITING_CHOICE, CHAT), and updates the session data.

Data Enrichment & RAG: If the data collection for a reading is complete, the engine coordinates background calls to parse location strings, grab coordinates via Nominatim, determine timezone details, and fetch context files from Google Drive.

Response Delivery: The workflow dynamically routes the execution path to either send operational messages or full AI/astrological readings back to the user via Telegram.

Setup steps
[ ] Add your Telegram Bot API credentials to the trigger and reply nodes.

[ ] Connect your Supabase credentials and verify that your sessions table matches the core fields (chat_id, state, mode, p1_data, p2_data).

[ ] Authenticate your Google Drive node to allow the engine to access your reference data (synastry.json).

[ ] Verify your Astro API / GeoNames credentials for geo-data enrichment.

Customization
You can expand the switch-case conditions inside the Logic Engine node to handle advanced interactive states or modify the Parse Intake Data structure to accept localized date-time formatting patterns.
